::: {#def-graph .theorem}
## Graph

An ordered pair $\mathscr{G} = (\mathcal{N}, \psi)$ with node set $\mathcal{N}$and adjacency function $\psi$. The adjacecy function assigns a nonnegative weight to each unordered pair of nodes $(i,j)$. 

$$
\mathscr G=(\mathcal N,\psi),\qquad
\psi:\mathcal N\times\mathcal N\to \mathbb R_{\ge 0},\qquad
\psi(i,j)=\psi(j,i)
$$

Nodes $i,j \in \mathcal{N}$ are connected if and only if $\psi(i,j) > 0$.
:::
